chapter: Reel IV retellings and New York pianists
title: Valaida Snow and the Berry Brothers
summary: He recalls trumpet player and singer Valaida Snow, Russell Smith giving her a car, the Blackbirds, and the Berry Brothers.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Yeah. Her and Valaida Snow --
: Yeah, let's mention that. We were talking about piano players, but this was a very talented woman.
Oh yeah.
And he had some very talented women there, you know. Name some -- tell them about her.
Valaida Snow was a trumpet player and a singer, excellent, and she -- Russell Smith, one of the Smith boys in the band.
Russell Smith and Joe Smith.
Joe Smith and John Smith.
Oh, there was a John Smith, too?
Yeah, there were three of them.
Is that so?
Yeah, and they --
And all three of them play trumpet?
Yeah, all three were trumpet players, and Russell gave her a car, and she drove to New York with it.
Now where was this with the car? What town was she in?
Oh, she was up in Boston. They were up in Boston.
Oh, I see.
Yeah, and she drove and went to New York -- drove her to New York. And Valaida, oh, she was great to me.
Okay, now what did she do when she got to New York? Russell gave her this car, so now continue with the story.
She went on to New York, and she you know, she played with Lou Leslie and his Blackbirds.
The Blackbirds, right. That's what we want to get to.
Yeah, she played in that show.
What was her part in that show? What did she do? Can you remember?
She had a part just like Florence Mills. Florence Mills had a part and she had a part -- and she ...
Were they both in the Blackbirds?
I think they were. But ...
Valaida Snow played trumpet, huh? Was she a good trumpet player?
Oh yeah, she was a great trumpet player. Yeah. She could play --
And she sang.
And she would sing.
Did she play piano at all, I wonder?
No, I don't think so. I don't remember that.
I remember seeing her.
Yeah. She had a sister named Valeda or something, and anyway, her sister was in the chorus, too, she sang. But she wasn't as talented as Valaida
Yeah.
The Berry brothers were crazy about Valaida.
Yeah, that's another great act peforming there, the Berry Brothers.
Yeah, Berry Brothers.
There was Ananias, James and ...
James and -- Warren.
Warren, right. I think Warren is the only one that's still living.
Yeah, I think so, too.
Yes. But what a great act it was, I tell you.
Well, they were stars -- they were one of the greatest acts going, because they were so smooth and so beautiful.
Who was the greatest of them?
Oh, Ananias. He was the great one -- he was suave, you know?
Right.
